items.title: Frustulin-mediated antimicrobial peptide display restricts ciliate contamination in Phaeodactylum tricornutum.
items.hook: The study engineered a frustulin-based antimicrobial peptide display that limits ciliate contamination in Phaeodactylum tricornutum cultures.

items.title: Rapid enrichment of auto-floating microalgae from river-derived microalgal communities.
items.hook: The paper reports a rapid enrichment protocol for auto‑floating microalgae from river communities, enabling low‑energy biomass harvesting.

items.title: Integrating biomass production platform and identification approach for stereochemical assignment of super-carbon-chain compounds.
items.hook: The authors integrated a biomass production platform with a stereochemical assignment approach to identify super‑carbon‑chain compounds from marine microalgae.

items.title: Promotion of nisin production by developing a surfactant-assisted microalgae-bacteria symbiotic system.
items.hook: Developed a surfactant-assisted microalgae-bacteria system that boosts nisin production by Lactococcus lactis.

items.title: Metal-based engineered nanoparticles and aquatic phototrophic microorganisms: From single-species to natural communities interactions.
items.hook: Explored how metal-based engineered nanoparticles affect aquatic phototrophic microorganisms from single species to natural communities.

items.title: Algal composition and toxigenic risk decouple from nutrient levels across eutrophic lakes.
items.hook: The study shows algal community structure and toxigenic risk vary along trophic gradients, decoupling from nutrient levels in eutrophic lakes.

items.title: Functional analysis of the U-box ubiquitin E3 ligase gene Gracilariopsis lemaneiformis GlPRP19 in heat stress response.
items.journal: Plant science : an international journal of experimental plant biology
items.hook: The study shows that the U-box E3 ligase GlPRP19 in Gracilariopsis lemaneiformis is involved in heat stress response.

items.title: Recurrent features of stress response in the unicellular zygnematophyte Mesotaenium: intracellular inclusions and vacuoles forming upon UV.
items.hook: The research demonstrates that Mesotaenium forms intracellular inclusions and vacuoles in response to UV stress.

items.title: Emerging inhalation risks: Global distribution of airborne algal and cyanobacterial toxins.
items.hook: Global distribution of airborne algal and cyanobacterial toxins shows emerging inhalation risks.

items.title: Anabaena, a multicellular model for cyanobacterial cell biology and biotechnology.
items.hook: Anabaena serves as a multicellular model for cyanobacterial cell biology and biotechnology.
